title: Influencer Marketing Associate
subtitle: About PATI Group
body:
## About PATI Group

PATI is a fast-growing E-commerce business specializing in dietary supplements, achieving a remarkable 500% increase in sales within just one year in the United States market. We're on a mission to become the leading dietary supplement company in Vietnam by 2026, offering innovative and high-quality products that inspire our customers to optimize their physical, mental, and intellectual potential.

As we continue our rapid growth trajectory, we're seeking a visionary **Influencer Marketing Associate** to lead our marketing efforts and drive us towards these goals.

## Job Summary

As our Influencer Marketing Associate, you will have the opportunity to work directly with **Top Tier Global Influencers** (especially in the US) to promote our supplement brands. You play a vital role in partnering and harnessing the power of influencers to grow our brand awareness, engagement, and ultimately drive business goals through several effective campaigns.

## **Essential Roles and Responsibilities**

- **Influencer campaign strategy and planning:** Researching new trends, making strategies aligned with overall marketing goals and identifying suitable global influencers based on target audience demographics, brand alignment,...

- **Influencer outreach and relationship management: **Reaching out to potential global influencers, negotiating terms of collaboration, building and maintaining relationships to ensure ongoing partnerships.

- **Content coordination and creation:** Providing creative direction or briefs to influencers to guide content creation, ensure it aligns with brand guidelines and campaign objectives.

- **Campaign execution and monitoring:** Managing the execution of influencer campaigns, monitoring campaign performance and analyzing key metrics to assess effectiveness.

- **Content and Social Media Management:** Scripting and making high-quality videos for our social media platforms besides managing global creators.

- **Stay updated on industry trends: **Keeping abreast of trends and developments in influencer marketing and social media platforms; Identifying emerging influencers and trends that could be beneficial for future campaigns.

## **Skills and Qualifications**

- More than 1 year of experience in the field of working with KOL/KOC/Creator (especially good at updating trends and creating scripts/brief).

- Fluent in English communication (Written and Spoken), with an IELTS score above 6.5 or equivalent.

- Have basic understanding about design knowledge.

- Proficiency with CapCut (or Premiere, After Effects,...).

- Strong critical thinking and creative content analysis skills.

- Strong leadership skills. Candidates need to provide proof of record of how they can increase their own team performance.

- Proactive learning behaviour. We request all people to learn daily (only learn things that can support your work immediately) and share it with others.

- A positive, “can do” attitude.

- Understand our core values: Honor Our Word, Play Like A Teamsport, Foster Innovation. You can check it out here: patigroup.com. If you think this is something you have, give us proof.

## **Come join PATI, you will have a chance to enjoy**

- 12.000.000 VND - 15.000.000 VND + incentive based on performance (negotiate). Total income can be up to 17.000.000 VND.

- Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic Global Ecommerce environment.

- Opportunity to access courses in psychology, storytelling, and content creation taught by leading US content creators.

- Being equipped with the best AI tools on the market for content production.

- To fully enjoy other social welfare regimes such as: social insurance, statutory leave,...

- Joining various team bonding activities.

We are looking for someone who shares our passion for wellness, our commitment to excellence, and our dedication to making a positive impact on our customers' lives. If you believe you have the skills and mindset to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you.

Company Address: 152 Dien Bien Phu Street, Ward 25, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh city

**🚀 APPLY [HERE](https://paticreativeagency.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrusjCC2CJeEWBc1wNKIX7fibc)**
